title: Wildcard SSL/TLS Certificate Renewal for api.corp.example.internal
business_justification: Renew public SSL/TLS certificate prior to expiration on Nov 25.

pre_checks.description: Inspect existing certificate expiration date and serial number
pre_checks.command: echo | openssl s_client -servername api.corp.example.internal -connect 192.0.2.10:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates

implementation_steps.action: Upload new certificate and intermediate CA chain to Load Balancer standby node
Bind certificate to HTTPS listener profile on standby node and test
Perform graceful traffic shift to updated node and repeat binding on primary node

rollback_plan.trigger_conditions: TLS handshake error rate > 0.1% or certificate chain validation errors.

commands.action: Re-point HTTPS listener profile to previous certificate file

verification_plan.description: Verify external TLS handshake and new expiry date
verification_plan.command: echo | openssl s_client -servername api.corp.example.internal -connect 192.0.2.10:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates
